RESIDENTIAL TENANCY & PG ACCOMMODATION AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on this 1st day of October, 2026, between Mr. R. K. Sharma (hereinafter referred to as the "Landlord/Owner") and the Tenant/Occupant (hereinafter referred to as the "Resident").

WHEREAS the Owner agrees to let out Room 302 located at Green Valley Residency, and the Resident agrees to take on lease the premises under the following binding terms and conditions:

1. RENT & SECURITY DEPOSIT
1.1 The Resident shall pay a monthly rent of INR 18,500 on or before the 1st day of each calendar month. Any delay beyond the 2nd day shall attract an immediate penalty of INR 500 per day.
1.2 The Resident has deposited an interest-free Security Deposit of INR 55,500. 
1.3 Upon vacating, a mandatory non-negotiable deduction of INR 12,000 shall be made from the deposit towards mandatory repainting and deep sanitization, regardless of the tenancy duration or condition of walls.
1.4 The remaining balance of the security deposit shall be refunded within 90 days following vacant possession.

2. LOCK-IN PERIOD & TERMINATION
2.1 This agreement carries a strict Lock-in Period of 6 (six) months from the commencement date. 
2.2 If the Resident vacates or issues notice before the completion of 6 months, the entire security deposit shall be forfeited, and the Resident shall additionally remain liable to pay the rent for the remainder of the lock-in period.
2.3 Notice Period: The Resident must provide 60 (sixty) days written notice prior to vacating. The Owner reserves the right to terminate the tenancy at any time by giving 7 (seven) days verbal or written notice without citing reasons.

3. MAINTENANCE, REPAIRS & USAGE
3.1 The Resident shall bear the full cost of all internal repairs, plumbing fixes, electrical appliance breakdowns, and routine servicing, irrespective of pre-existing wear and tear.
3.2 Major structural repairs exceeding INR 5,000 shall be split equally between the Landlord and Resident.

4. ENTRY, INSPECTION & HOUSE RULES
4.1 The Landlord, building supervisor, or designated agents reserve the right to enter and inspect the premises at any hour of the day or night without prior notice to verify compliance with house regulations.
4.2 Guests, family members, or overnight visitors are strictly prohibited. Any unauthorized guest identified on premises will attract a fine of INR 1,500 per day.
4.3 Quiet hours commence strictly at 9:30 PM. Failure to adhere will result in immediate lease cancellation.

5. RENT ESCALATION & LEGAL INDEMNITY
5.1 The Landlord reserves the unilateral right to increase the monthly rent by up to 15% at any point after 6 months upon 15 days notice.
5.2 The Resident agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Landlord against any municipal disputes, damages, structural failures, or utility cuts occurring during the occupancy.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF the parties hereto have signed this agreement on the day, month, and year first written above.

Landlord Signature: ___________________
Resident Signature: ___________________

questions.question: Clause specifies a mandatory deduction for painting upon vacating. Can we amend this so deductions apply only to actual physical damages beyond normal wear and tear, supported by itemized repair invoices?
questions.why: Prevents paying for normal wall aging or previous tenants' paint decay.

questions.question: The current draft allows the owner 7 days to terminate but requires 60 days from the tenant. Can we make this a mutual 30-day notice period for both parties?
questions.why: Ensures you aren't evicted unexpectedly without time to find a new room.

questions.question: In the event of an unavoidable college transfer, job relocation, or health emergency, can we include a clause allowing termination during lock-in if I give 30 days notice or help find a replacement?
questions.why: Protects you from losing your entire deposit and being held liable for unlived rent.

questions.question: Regarding owner or warden inspections, can we add a requirement of at least 24 hours advance written or telephone notice before room entry, except in emergencies?
questions.why: Protects your fundamental right to privacy and personal dignity.

checklist.title: Document Existing Condition with Photos & Video
checklist.description: Take high-resolution photos and video of all walls, tiles, geyser, taps, and pre-existing furniture marks on move-in day. Email them to the owner to establish timestamped proof.

checklist.title: Note Down Electricity & Water Meter Readings
checklist.description: Photograph the electricity sub-meter and confirm previous tenant's unpaid bills are settled before paying first month's advance.

checklist.title: Get Deposit & Rent Acknowledgment in Writing
checklist.description: Never pay deposit in unrecorded cash. Use bank transfer (UPI/NEFT) and ensure owner provides a signed receipt.

checklist.title: Check Mutual Notice Period Match
checklist.description: Confirm both tenant and owner have identical notice requirements (e.g. 30 days each).

checklist.title: Clarify Painting & Normal Wear-and-Tear Policy
checklist.description: Verify that wall painting is not an automatic deduction, but only charged if actual damage occurs.

checklist.title: Test All Locks & Request Duplicate Key Policy
checklist.description: Test main door and room locks. Clarify who holds duplicate keys and verify owner entry notice.

PAYING GUEST ACCOMMODATION & RENTAL AGREEMENT

This Agreement is entered into on 1st August 2026, by and between Mr. R. K. Sharma (hereinafter referred to as the "OWNER/LANDLORD") and the undersigned Tenant/Resident (hereinafter referred to as the "LICENSEE/TENANT").

WHEREAS the Owner agrees to grant temporary license to the Tenant to occupy Room No. 204 in Sai Comforts Executive PG, Bengaluru, Karnataka.

NOW THIS INDENTURE WITNESSETH AND IT IS HEREBY MUTUALLY AGREED AS FOLLOWS:

1. RENT & PAYMENT SCHEDULE
The monthly license fee/rent shall be ₹18,000 (Rupees Eighteen Thousand Only) inclusive of basic water and high-speed Wi-Fi, payable strictly in advance on or before the 1st day of each English calendar month. If rent is not credited by the 3rd of the month, a mandatory late fee penalty of ₹300 per day will be levied automatically. If payment is delayed past the 7th, the Owner reserves the right to disconnect electricity and lock the premises.

2. SECURITY DEPOSIT & MANDATORY DEDUCTIONS
The Tenant has deposited an interest-free refundable Security Deposit of ₹45,000 (Rupees Forty-Five Thousand Only). Upon vacating the premises, a mandatory non-negotiable deduction of ₹14,000 will be made towards deep cleaning, repainting, and air-conditioner sanitation, regardless of the tenant's length of stay or the physical condition of the room upon departure. The remaining balance shall be refunded within 60 days following physical handover.

3. LOCK-IN PERIOD & FORFEITURE
The Tenant agrees to a mandatory Lock-in Period of 6 (six) months from the commencement date. If the Tenant vacates, absconds, or terminates this agreement before completing the 6-month lock-in period for any reason (including college transfer, job loss, or illness), the entire Security Deposit of ₹45,000 shall be forfeited immediately. In addition, the Tenant remains legally bound to pay the full monthly rent for the remaining unexpired months of the lock-in period.

4. NOTICE PERIOD ASYMMETRY
The Tenant must serve a minimum of 60 (sixty) days advance written notice prior to vacating the accommodation. However, the Owner reserves the absolute right to terminate this agreement and require the Tenant to vacate within 7 (seven) days notice without assigning any cause or reason whatsoever.

5. MAINTENANCE, REPAIRS & REPLACEMENTS
The Tenant shall bear 100% of all expenses for repair, servicing, maintenance, and replacement of all fixtures inside the room, including geysers, plumbing taps, electrical fittings, door locks, and drainage unclogging. Any repair exceeding ₹500 shall be paid directly by the Tenant. The Owner shall not be held liable for structural maintenance or roof seepage.

6. UNRESTRICTED RIGHT OF INSPECTION & ENTRY
The Owner, property warden, or authorized maintenance personnel shall retain duplicate master keys and reserve the unrestricted right to enter and inspect the Tenant's room at any time of day or night without prior notice to verify cleanliness or enforce house rules.

7. CURFEW, VISITORS & GUEST PENALTIES
Strict quiet hours begin at 9:00 PM. No visitors, parents, or friends of any gender are permitted inside the room after 8:00 PM. Any unauthorized guest presence inside the room beyond 8:00 PM will incur an automatic fine of ₹1,000 per occurrence and may result in immediate summary eviction without deposit refund.

8. RENT ESCALATION & VARIATION
The Owner reserves the unilateral right to increase the monthly rent by up to 15% at any point during the tenancy upon serving a 15-day email intimation, owing to rising electricity tariffs and property maintenance costs.

9. JURISDICTION & INDEMNITY
The Tenant agrees to indemnify and hold harmless the Owner against all legal claims, accidents, or losses arising on the premises. In the event of any legal dispute, only the local civil court designated by the Owner shall hold jurisdiction.
